presets.name: Netflix UK Standard
presets.notes: No UK free trial. Standard 1080p plan is £13.99/mo (Standard with Ads is £7.99/mo, Premium 4K is £20.99/mo). Instant online cancellation.

presets.name: Spotify Premium UK
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £11.99/mo Individual plan (Student £5.99/mo, Duo £16.99/mo). Cancelling downgrades to Spotify Free without losing playlists.

presets.name: Disney+ UK Standard
presets.notes: No UK free trial. Standard 1080p plan is £11.99/mo (£119.90/yr). Standard with Ads is £6.99/mo; Premium 4K is £15.99/mo. Cancel online anytime.

presets.name: Amazon Prime UK
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £8.99/mo (£95/yr). Ad-free Prime Video costs an extra £2.99/mo. Warning: Trial defaults to an automatic £95/year annual renewal if not switched.

presets.name: Apple TV+ UK
presets.notes: 7-day free trial. £9.99/mo (£89.99/yr). IMMEDIATE CUTOFF TRAP: If you cancel during the 7-day trial, Apple terminates access instantly. Set alert for day 6.

presets.name: NOW TV (Cinema / Entertainment)
presets.notes: 7-day free trial on Entertainment or Cinema (£9.99/mo). Warning: NOW Boost (£6/mo) is pre-checked as a separate 7-day trial during checkout.

presets.name: Sky Stream & TV
presets.notes: 14-day statutory cooling-off. Rolling monthly plan (£34/mo) requires strict 31 days advance notice to cancel. 24-month contract locks you in with early exit penalties.

presets.name: YouTube Premium UK
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £12.99/mo individual (£129.99/yr). iOS APP STORE TRAP: Subscribing inside Apple's iOS app charges £16.99/mo. Always sign up via web browser.

presets.name: Audible UK
presets.notes: 30-day free trial (includes 1 free credit). £7.99/mo. UNSPENT CREDIT TRAP: Spend all credits before cancelling—unused credits disappear immediately upon cancellation.

presets.name: BBC TV Licence
presets.notes: 14-day cooling-off. £180.00/yr (£15.00/mo). New Direct Debits bill ~£30/mo for first 6 months to create a buffer. Cancel online if you declare you do not watch live TV or iPlayer.

presets.name: DAZN UK Sports
presets.notes: No free trial. SEVERE NOTICE TRAP: Monthly Flex (£25.99/mo) enforces a mandatory 30-day notice period with a final pro-rata bill. Annual contract (£15.99/mo) has zero early exit.

presets.name: Paramount+ UK Standard
presets.notes: 7-day free trial. Standard 1080p plan is £9.99/mo (Basic with Ads is £5.99/mo, Premium 4K is £12.99/mo). Cancel in account settings 24h prior to renewal.

presets.name: Discovery+ UK (TNT Sports)
presets.notes: No free trial. £30.99/mo rolling monthly pass for TNT Sports (Premier League, UEFA Champions League, UFC, boxing & MotoGP). Cancel online anytime.

presets.name: The Guardian Digital
presets.notes: 14-day free trial on mobile apps. £12.00/mo All-Access Digital (ad-free web and premium Guardian & Feast apps). Basic web articles remain free.

presets.name: PureGym Membership
presets.notes: 14-day statutory cooling-off. Core plan averages £23.99/mo. Cancel online via member dashboard at least 4 working days before Direct Debit payment.

presets.name: The Gym Group
presets.notes: 14-day cooling-off. Standard 'Do It' membership is £21.99/mo (off-peak from £15.99/mo). Cancel via online member portal or bank Direct Debit 4 days prior.

presets.name: David Lloyd Clubs
presets.notes: 14-day cooling-off. SEVERE CONTRACT LOCK-IN: Requires 3 full calendar months written notice to cancel after your initial 12-month commitment expires.

presets.name: JD Gyms UK
presets.notes: 14-day cooling-off. £22.99/mo standard plan. WARNING: Do NOT just cancel your Direct Debit—submit their online cancellation form 14 days in advance to avoid arrears.

presets.name: Virgin Active UK
presets.notes: 14-day cooling-off. Standard club flexi membership is £109.00/mo. Requires formal 30-day written notice. Never cancel Direct Debit without written confirmation.

presets.name: Strava Subscription
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £8.99/mo (£54.99/yr). ANNUAL BILLING TRAP: Most 30-day trial signups default to billing the £54.99 annual plan at day 30 unless set to monthly.

presets.name: MyFitnessPal Premium
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £15.99/mo (£64.99/yr). Warning: Trial automatically rolls into £64.99 annual charge on day 30 unless explicitly changed or cancelled.

presets.name: WHOOP 4.0 Membership
presets.notes: 30-day free trial (£27.00/mo after). HARDWARE RETURN TRAP: You must cancel online AND post the sensor and pack back within the return window, or you will be charged a £110+ hardware fee or annual lock-in.

presets.name: Headspace Meditation
presets.notes: 7-day free trial on monthly plan (£9.99/mo). Note: 14-day trial option signs you up for £49.99/yr annual billing.

presets.name: Calm Premium
presets.notes: 7-day free trial. £11.99/mo. Trap alert: The 7-day trial automatically defaults to a £39.99/yr annual charge unless cancelled 24 hours before expiration.

presets.name: PlayStation Plus
presets.notes: No free trial in the UK. Extra tier is £10.99/mo (Essential is £6.99/mo, Premium is £13.49/mo). Turn off auto-renewal via account settings.

presets.name: Xbox Game Pass Ultimate
presets.notes: No free trial. £16.99/mo (occasional £1 for 14 days promo). Cancel recurring billing online in Microsoft Services & Subscriptions.

presets.name: Nintendo Switch Online
presets.notes: 7-day free trial. £3.49/mo (or £17.99/yr). Warning: Auto-renewal is switched on automatically upon starting the trial; turn off auto-renewal immediately in eShop.

presets.name: ChatGPT Plus
presets.notes: No free trial. £19.99/mo via app store or $20 + 20% UK VAT (~£19.20) via Stripe. Instant online cancellation via My Plan.

presets.name: Claude Pro (Anthropic)
presets.notes: No free trial. £18.00/mo (approx $20 + UK VAT) managed directly via Stripe portal. Cancel anytime before monthly renewal.

presets.name: Apple iCloud+ (200GB)
presets.notes: No free trial. £2.99/mo for 200GB (Family Sharing included). Downgrade to 5GB free tier anytime in iPhone iCloud settings.

presets.name: Google One (Cloud / AI)
presets.notes: 30-day free trial on Google One AI Premium (£18.99/mo); Standard 2TB is £7.99/mo. Cancel online in Google One membership settings.

presets.name: Microsoft 365 Personal
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £8.49/mo (£84.99/yr) includes Word, Excel, 1TB OneDrive & Copilot AI. Warning: Free trial automatically defaults to £84.99 annual billing if not cancelled.

presets.name: NordVPN UK
presets.notes: 30-day money-back guarantee shield: Requires upfront payment, then requesting a refund via 24/7 live chat before day 30. Rolling monthly renewal is £10.99/mo.

presets.name: ExpressVPN
presets.notes: 30-day money-back guarantee (requires contact with live support for refund). Rolling monthly plan is £10.49/mo. 7-day true free trial is iOS/Android mobile only.

presets.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
presets.notes: 7-day free trial. MAJOR CONTRACT TRAP: Cancelling after day 14 of an annual commitment triggers Adobe's early cancellation fee of up to 50% of the remaining contract value!

presets.name: Canva Pro UK
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £12.99/mo (£99.99/yr). Instant online cancellation; designs remain accessible on Canva Free tier.

presets.name: Deliveroo Plus (Silver)
presets.notes: 14-day free trial. £3.49/mo for orders over £15. Secret tip: Deliveroo Plus Silver is free for 12 months if linked with Amazon Prime!

presets.name: Uber One UK
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £4.99/mo (£49.99/yr). CRITICAL DEADLINE: Must cancel at least 48 hours prior to renewal date, otherwise the system locks cancellation until the next cycle.

presets.name: Just Eat+
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £5.99/mo. Free delivery on orders over £15 from participating restaurants. Cancel anytime in account settings.

presets.name: HelloFresh UK
presets.notes: Introductory promo discount (not £0 free). Weekly rolling deliveries. Strict cut-off: Must skip or cancel by Wednesday 11:59 PM before your delivery week.

presets.name: Gousto Recipe Box
presets.notes: Intro promo discount. Auto-renews weekly. Must pause or cancel before the 12:00 PM noon deadline 3 days before scheduled box delivery.

presets.name: Club Pret Subscription
presets.notes: No free trial. £10.00/mo (replaces former £30 coffee pass) gives 50% off up to 5 barista-made drinks/day. Cancel anytime in Pret account.

presets.name: Tesco Clubcard Plus
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £7.99/mo. Offers 10% off two in-store grocery shops per month (up to £40/mo savings). Both discounts can be used during the trial.

presets.name: ASOS Premier UK
presets.notes: Billed at £9.95/yr upfront. 14-day statutory cooling-off refund applies ONLY if you have placed 0 orders using Premier delivery. Requires £15 min spend for next-day delivery.

presets.name: Experian CreditExpert
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £14.99/mo. Free trial unlocks full credit report and score simulator; cancels smoothly to basic free Experian account.

presets.name: ClearScore Protect
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £4.99/mo dark web & ID fraud monitoring add-on. Core ClearScore credit report and monthly score remain 100% free forever.

presets.name: Equifax Credit Report & Score
presets.notes: 30-day free trial. £14.95/mo. Full Equifax statutory credit report with WebDetect alert protection. Cancel in MyEquifax settings.

presets.name: Monzo Perks / Max
presets.notes: 14-day cooling-off window. Monzo Perks is £7.00/mo; Monzo Max is £17.00/mo. IMPORTANT: A 3-month minimum term applies if you keep the plan past day 14.

presets.name: Revolut Premium / Metal
presets.notes: 30-day trial (£8.99/mo after). CRITICAL CONTRACT TRAP: Paid Revolut plans are 12-month commitments. Cancelling after your trial/cooling-off incurs a 2-month break fee (£17.98) plus physical card delivery costs.
